fusions.name: Darting Slivers
fusions.desc: Looses 3 silver slivers in a spread, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Under the Gill Plate
fusions.desc: Slides a needle under the target's guard, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. For 3 seconds afterwards, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and you slip 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Never Quite Caught
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a blow that would have hit you rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
